question: Will the 10-year minus 3-month U.S. Treasury par yield spread (Treasury daily par yield curve, percentage points) for 2025-08-14 (or the last business day before it with a published reading) be above 0.15 pp?

rule.threshold_basis: a round number near the upper quartile of historical moves over the same distance

source: Source: U.S. Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
